#### Manage your subscription

# Google Play subscriptions

If you bought Grok, Grok Bot, or X Premium through Google Play, check your subscriptions in Google Play after you switch to The X Subscription. If it's still set to renew, cancel it there.

Manage your Google Play billing in Google Play.
